topic: What antenna aperture size trade-offs exist between LEO and GEO satellites when optimizing gain and portability for CMOS-based ground terminals?
consensus_response: LEO satellites favor smaller apertures for portability, while GEO prioritizes larger apertures for gain. Phased arrays and AI-driven beamforming optimize aperture size, improving directivity and reducing interference, but increase computational complexity and power consumption.
reference_context: SatCom systems involve trade-offs between antenna gain, portability, and power consumption, with LEO and GEO satellites having different requirements due to their orbits and signal propagation characteristics.
